name: Wayfinder Guild
subtitle: Agentic travel portfolio with Spring AI
description: Wayfinder Guild is the public portfolio product for the Spring Boot, Java 21, Spring AI, DeepSeek, Vue, and Phaser travel-agent showcase.
highlights: WayfinderTravelController keeps the HTTP boundary thin while WayfinderTravelFacade preserves compatibility.
Travel planning is split across chat, report, RAG, tool, MCP, and SSE services.
Skills, structured TravelPlan output, Eval Harness, Guardrails, and Agent Trace are visible as product capabilities.
RPG metadata powers the public Wayfinder Guild map and capability pages.

name: SyManus Tool Agent
subtitle: Tool-using AI engineer assistant
description: A tool-calling agent prototype that demonstrates search, files, terminal boundaries, downloads, streaming feedback, and guardrails.
highlights: Encapsulates tool capabilities behind tested service boundaries.
Uses guarded tools to reduce unsafe or unauthorized actions.
Keeps multi-turn context for longer tool-assisted tasks.

name: Wayfinder Guild Metadata
subtitle: Portfolio metadata foundation
description: The metadata layer behind the Wayfinder Guild map, NPCs, capability pages, project cards, skills, modules, and profile panel.
highlights: Uses JSON resources to describe the explorable portfolio town.
Keeps controllers focused on protocol handling while services load and query resources.
Provides stable metadata for Vue and Phaser rendering.
